Confirm your email

[[MESSAGE]]

Confirm email

Button not working? Paste this link into your browser:
[[ACTION_URL]]

Use the button or the code

Select the button, or type the six-digit code on the sign-in page. Either one works.

It expires soon

The link and code work once and stop working after a short time. If they expire, ask for a new one from the sign-in page.

Keep the code private

Pheelm will never ask you for it by email, message or phone.

Didn’t create an account? You can ignore this email. Nothing happens unless the address is confirmed.

You’re getting this because of your Pheelm account or a request you made to Pheelm.

security-notice.html:
The email address on your Pheelm account was changed. ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿ ‌​‍﻿

Your sign-in email changed

[[MESSAGE]]

Review this change

Button not working? Paste this link into your browser:
[[ACTION_URL]]

What changed

The email address used to sign in to your account was updated. The old and the new address both receive this notice.

If it was you

Nothing more to do. Use the new address to sign in from now on.

If it wasn’t you

Write to hey@pheelm.com right away with “Account security” in the subject, and we’ll help you recover your account.

Pheelm never asks for your password or sign-in code. We only email you about changes like this one.

You’re getting this because of your Pheelm account or a request you made to Pheelm.

[[MESSAGE]]

Contact us

Button not working? Paste this link into your browser:
[[ACTION_URL]]

What was removed

Your profile, watchlists, follows, comments, notifications and profile photo were deleted along with your account.

Emails stop

Want to come back?

You’re welcome to create a new account any time. Deleted content can’t be restored.

Didn’t delete your account? Write to hey@pheelm.com straight away so we can look into it.

You’re getting this because of your Pheelm account or a request you made to Pheelm.
